overview.description: The Guinness Atkinson Global Innovators Fund: ETF Class Shares (GAIQ) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in stocks based on a particular theme. The fund is an actively managed ETF that invests in companies worldwide that the fund adviser believes are positioned for growth through advances in technology, communications, globalism, or innovative management. The fund seeks long-term capital appreciation. GAIQ was launched on Aug 12, 2026 and is issued by Guinness Atkinson.

holdings.infoBox: GAIQ is an equity ETF with a total of 33 individual holdings. The top holdings are Salesforce stock at 4.04%, Microsoft at 3.83%, Nasdaq at 3.78%, Amazon.com at 3.78%, and Roper Technologies at 3.72%.
